pages.title: To Mine and Snow
pages.text: Some companions help underground, others on snowy journeys.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Dry-biome Ringtails accept Glow Berries for mining friendship. Feed cold-biome Caribou red mushrooms then saddle. Food interaction without its resulting assistance/riding does not count.
